title: sheer curtains
text: sheer curtains. These are sheer, white... but are more loose mesh that I had hoped.  They will work.. but the mesh is not really a look that I like. I guess that's the part that is "linen"... if so, it's VERY loose linen.

features: Material: Made of 100% Polyester, Faux Semi Sheer Linen Textured Fabric.
Package Details: Each package includes 2 panels tier curtains. Each panel measures W36" x L24".
Good Design: Dual rod pockets top design adds a touch of elegance. Rod Pocket insert can fit most rods up to 1.5".

Serve Well: These sheer window treatments are soft drapery. Provide your privacy while allow the sunshine to gently stream into your room. If sun shine through your window is strong enough, we recommend you choose those blackout or thicker curtains.
Multiple Functions: These sheer curtain panels are suitable for kitchen, café room, bathroom, laundry room & studio etc. They can hang alone or match with other curtains.
Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, low iron as needed. Any issue, feel free to contact us.
